SOMA precision ring - selected 3D version A

The machined ring geometry and procedural metal textures are project-specific
code reconstructed from the supplied illustration. They are not recovered CAD.
The satin finish and central-axis rotation use option A. Wide screens retain
its comparison camera; the phone camera follows the original static framing.
Matching first-frame posters are rendered from this model for loading and
fallback. These are code renders, not new AI images or edits of the old photo.

The complete license is included in THREE-LICENSE.txt.

Reflection environment: Studio Small 09 by Sergej Majboroda, Poly Haven, CC0.

Downloaded at 2K from the official Poly Haven file API.
